### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => { const rows=[];for(const width of [320,390,768,1440]){await page.setViewportSize({width,height:900});for(const view of ['console','records','connections']){await page.locator('a[data-view="'+view+'"]').evaluate(e=>e.click());rows.push(await page.evaluate(()=>({width:innerWidth,view:location.hash,scroll:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth})));}}await page.locator('a[data-view="console"]').evaluate(e=>e.click());await page.locator('#pause').evaluate(e=>{if(e.textContent==='暂停接收')e.click();});const paused=await page.locator('#system-modules tr').evaluateAll(rows=>rows.map(e=>e.dataset.state));await page.locator('#pause').evaluate(e=>e.click());await page.waitForTimeout(1000);return {layouts:rows,paused,visibility:await page.evaluate(()=>document.visibilityState)}; })(page);
```
